base: PR #110 stereo engine (f4d4f6d) plus PR for #30 WAV import (331d541)
scope: Track pan, mute and solo with stereo desktop output, Undo, persistence and stereo export through the mixer
environment: Kvant, pinned CI image (Qt 6.12.0, PipeWire 1.6.9), docker --network none
verified_behaviors: TrackMix (pan -100..100, mute, solo) lives on each document track; duplicate copies it; deleting the last soloed track releases solo

Render preparation applies mute/solo as zero gain and pan through the engine balance law; four-track per-channel output matches an independent oracle for pan, mute, solo, mute-beats-solo at blocks 1 and 257
Metadata adds required feature track-mixer-v1 only when a mix differs from default; identity-only files keep their bytes; malformed mix fields and feature/field mismatches are refused
Desktop renders stereo (PipeWire FL/FR, stereo silent preview); pan/mute/solo are stopped edits with Undo/Redo, refused while playing or out of range, and persist through Save/Open
Stereo export decoded per channel equals independent per-track renders mixed with the declared law for center, pan, mute, mute-beats-solo, solo and two solos
Actual offscreen keyboard pan entry (arrow and typed R35), pointer mute/solo, keyboard solo, Undo/Redo and disabled controls while playing
Private PipeWire workflow: QML solo and hard-left pan on the MIDI track; independent stereo capture has A4 at peak 0.02 on the left and exact silence on the right
limits: Mixer edits are stopped edits (playback edits are #54). Offline, offscreen and private software-graph results; physical output, native Wayland and latency remain unqualified.
